newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 12.7 PCT IN H1.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 12.7 PCT IN H1.

text.p: Estonian industrial sales rose by 12.7 percent during the first six months of this year compared with the same period in 1996, the country's statistics office said on Tuesday.
Manufacturing sales rose by 16.2 percent in the same period, the department added in a statement.
The biggest increases were in the sales of wood manufacturing at 52.7 percent, that of construction materials manufacturing at 38.3 percent and that of rubber and plastic products at 36.7 percent.
During the first six months of 1997, sales decreased in wearing apparel, machinery and equipment and electrical machinery and apparatus manufacturing.
In June, industrial sales rose by 16.9 percent compared with the same period last year.
Electricity production increased by 9.9 percent in June and heating production fell by six percent compared with June 1996.
